note: Company exists and is active in Indian customs data, but only as an IMPORTER of wheat gluten, wheat starch and whey (HS 1109, 1108, 0404) from Russia, Australia, Malaysia and the UK, latest record 2026-02-23, 80 shipments, 10 counterparties, 12 port lanes. Declared HS 170250 (chemically pure fructose) does not match any observed record; per project rules this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base with the code corrected to the actual observed HS (11090000 / 11081100). No traces of export shipments found; domestic supply evidence not verifiable with the tools available (search engine down, paid databases 403) — recorded as unknown, not as confirmed.
